Analytical Takeaway: The Clear Top 2 & High-Floor Elite

Shreyas Iyer (2.02) and Shubman Gill (1.99) stand out as statistical outliers with 93% bootstrap confidence. Both combine high strike rate elevation (+20 to +27 points above usual) with exceptional win-probability preservation under extreme leverage.

Analytical Takeaway: Hazlewood's Supremacy & Spin Choke

Josh Hazlewood (2.58) dominates the bowling rankings with 93% bootstrap confidence and 25 pressure wickets. Meanwhile, spinners like Krunal Pandya (7.79), Sunil Narine (6.97), and Sufiyan Muqeem (4.58) outperform traditional quicks through boundary suppression.
